quality_assessment: Excellent documentation with comprehensive coverage of binary modes. The page accurately documents all three binary modes (Auto, SearchAndSuppress, AsText) with clear explanations, visual diagrams, and practical examples. The documentation matches the implementation in crates/core/flags/lowargs.rs:231-252 and test behavior in tests/binary.rs. Already includes sophisticated MkDocs Material features (Mermaid diagrams, admonitions, code annotations). Minor improvements possible for completeness.

issues.description: Missing explicit mention of warning message format for SearchAndSuppress mode
issues.current_content: When you use the `--binary` flag, ripgrep will search binary files but suppress matches and emit warnings when NUL bytes are found
issues.should_be: Should include example warning message format: 'binary file matches (found "\0" byte around offset N)' for explicit files and 'WARNING: stopped searching binary file after match (found "\0" byte around offset N)' for implicit files
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a note or admonition showing the exact warning message format users will see in each scenario

issues.description: Could clarify what 'quit searching immediately' means for implicit files
issues.current_content: Implicit files (e.g., `rg pattern` in a directory, or `rg pattern -g '*.bin'`): Quits searching immediately when binary data is detected, no output or warning
issues.should_be: Could add clarification that 'quits searching' means stops reading the file and moves to next file, producing no output for that file at all (silent skip)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief clarification in parentheses explaining the silent skip behavior more explicitly

issues.description: Could mention edge case with --files-with-matches and --quiet flags
issues.current_content: Performance considerations section is good but doesn't mention specific edge cases
issues.should_be: Could add note that with -l/--files-with-matches or --quiet, binary detection may be skipped for performance (stops at first match before detecting NUL bytes)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add bullet point or tip box about edge cases with early-exit flags (-l, --quiet) where binary files might be reported as matching
issues.source_reference: tests/binary.rs:253-285, test comments at lines 253-261 explaining this is acceptable tradeoff
